# Dorian Award for TV Drama of the Year

}}
The Dorian Award for TV Drama of the Year is one of the main categories of Dorian Awards, given annually to the best TV drama series of the year by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association).
The Dorians go to both mainstream and LGBTQ-centric content.
